dinnerNote: Menu Prestige (DKK 2,420 with the caviar course)
dinnerNoteZh: Prestige 套餐（含魚子醬菜式 2,420 丹麥克朗）

menus.name: Menu Prestige
menus.note: Lunch Thursday to Saturday or dinner Wednesday to Saturday; pairing 6 glasses DKK 1,550, or DKK 2,700 for the Prestige pairing

menus.name: Menu Prestige with "Caviar en surprise"
menus.note: Adds the caviar and lobster course; pairing 7 glasses DKK 1,750, or DKK 3,000 for the Prestige pairing

menus.name: Kromenu, three courses
menus.note: Thursday to Saturday; put together on the day by the head chef; pairing 3 glasses

menus.name: Sunday lunch, three courses
menus.note: Sundays only, when it is the only menu; includes a glass of bubbles, matching wines, water, coffee and sweets (DKK 1,550 for four courses)

bookingOpens: Online through DinnerBooking, or by phone or email (mail@soelleroed-kro.dk).
groups: Parties and company events for 20 or more are held in the inn's function rooms: Søllerød Salen for 40 to 80, Gårdstuen for 20 to 50.
byob: Guests may bring up to two 75cl bottles per booking: corkage is DKK 800 for the first and DKK 1,200 for the second.
